verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation, compliance and bookkeeping SaaS, so AI-generated insights are a fair question for it. The only AI mention is "AI-powered, human-managed bookkeeping," which describes how the books are produced, not insights or suggestions surfaced to the user from their data. The compliance dashboard shows status and deadlines but is not described as AI-generated, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
